annotations.text:
This one is live, not a picture.

Click a slot in the bench list to load its parts on the right; click a part to fit it. Six stats, both deltas, the trader panel and the recoil plot all recompute from the real numbers.

Fit the Reactor compensator to watch a child Suppressor slot appear under Muzzle.

On "the bench takes too much space" — the Layout tweak above this artboard has a bench switch.

plate = weapon plate + one-column slot list (default)
lean  = no plate, two-column slot list, recoil panel goes full width with its own rounds and distance controls

Switch between them and pick; whichever you save becomes the file's default.
